scores.reasons: Gap: no schema, no meta, no prices, weak mobile first screen despite strong review volume. Ability: three stores and 14 years, order sizes in the hundreds. Ease: pages and quote agent are straightforward. Evidence: home, quote and contact pages, robots and mobile capture inspected.

caveats: Private dance/music/art/tutoring/driving schools were treated as commercial businesses rather than the excluded 'school' category (none are public K-12, college or district entities).

Flexy Custom Apparel runs three stores (two NJ, one MD) and Solution Prep runs four NJ centres. Treated as locally owned multi-location businesses, not national chains or franchises; both make their own local marketing decisions.
Phone-width checks were redone with an iPhone user agent; Wix (Allied, PM Music) serves a separate mobile layout that only appears with a mobile UA.

Several businesses show a phone on Google that differs from the phone on their website (Solution Prep, All Brunswick, Kilmer). Treated as a data-quality finding, not as evidence of a different business.
data_gaps: Google web search returned a bot check ('unusual traffic'), so ratings and review counts came from Google Maps result lists instead of search snippets.

Kilmer Driving School could not be rendered in the browser at all because of the HTTPS certificate error; its website review is based on fetched HTML/text only, so visual layout and phone-width behaviour could not be judged.
Lauren Morgan Designs publishes no street address anywhere on its site and its Maps entry shows no address or hours, so location detail remains unknown.
